subject.title: feat(runner): support OpenClaw plugins across the ClawHub profile

question: Should ClawScan expand its public skill-oriented target contract to treat explicit OpenClaw plugin packages as first-class targets across the built-in ClawHub profile?
rationale: The code is bounded and technically convincing, but it introduces a new public target kind, artifact identity field, and package-release judge semantics beyond current main's documented skill focus.

options.title: Sponsor plugin targets
options.body: Approve the new public target and artifact contract, then merge after confirming compatibility expectations for downstream artifact consumers.

options.title: Narrow the surface
options.body: Keep plugin support behind a separate experimental command or profile until the general public contract is settled.

options.title: Remain skills-only
options.body: Decline first-class plugin scanning and keep ClawScan's public scope limited to agent skills.

recommendation.title: Sponsor plugin targets
recommendation.body: Approve the new public target and artifact contract, then merge after confirming compatibility expectations for downstream artifact consumers.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent current-main ownership spans the runner, scanner profiles, documentation, and repository policy affected by this product-boundary choice.
